node.statement: Let R=I_X-P. The original unit is self-adjoint, so R is self-adjoint. The approximate-unit axioms in def-epsilon-cstar-algebra give ||I_X||<=1+epsilon_X<=2, ||I_X^2-I_X||<=epsilon_X||I_X||<=2epsilon_X, and ||I_XP-P||,||PI_X-P||<=epsilon_X||P||<=2epsilon_X. Using R^2-R=(I_X^2-I_X)-(I_XP-P)-(PI_X-P)+(P^2-P) and the preceding original defect bound yields ||R^2-R||<=(A+6)epsilon_X=C_proj epsilon_X. Thus I_X-P is also a C_proj epsilon_X-projection for the original product.
